metadata.description: Session workflow orchestration for Claude Code

plugins.name: session-flow
plugins.description: Complete 16-skill development lifecycle chain: init, research-design, task-planning, delegation, post-implementation, verification, work-root repair, release, plus security & liability audit. Each work item is recorded in a versioned work root under a project namespace, and the sequence (backlog) is generated from those records rather than edited by hand. Requires Python 3.9+ on the host. Features dependency-aware parallelization, collaborative brainstorming, and evidence-based verification.
